test_title: SSC CHSL 2025 Tier-1 (Held On: 29 Nov, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Choose the correct option to give a one-word substitution for the sentence given.

A person who does not drink any alcohol.
solution: The correct answer is: **Option 1 i.e. Teetotaler**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The word **"Teetotaler"** refers to a person who abstains completely from alcohol consumption. (शराब से पूर्ण रूप से परहेज करने वाला व्यक्ति) • **Example:** John is a teetotaler and prefers drinking juice at parties. • **"Non-drinker"** is also used for someone who does not drink alcohol but may not carry the strong implication of total abstinence like "Teetotaler." (शराब न पीने वाला व्यक्ति) • **Example:** Sarah is a non-drinker and avoids alcohol at social events. • Hence, the correct answer is **"Teetotaler."** Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1 i.e. Teetotaler**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Non-drinker** (शराब न पीने वाला): A person who does not consume alcohol but may not abstain totally in all situations. • **Example:** He is a non-drinker but occasionally enjoys a glass of wine for celebrations. • **Beverages man** (पेय पदार्थों का व्यक्ति): This is not a correct term in the context of alcohol abstinence. It refers to someone involved in the beverage industry or someone who enjoys beverages in general. • **Example:** The beverages man delivered a variety of drinks for the party. • **Tougher** (कठोर): Refers to someone who is strong or resilient but is unrelated to the context of alcohol consumption. • **Example:** He became tougher after facing difficult challenges in life. 35:T966, The correct answer is: **Option 2 i.e. Aquatic**.
